evals.source: .claude/skills/check-your-own-work/SKILL.md:80（四顆 PR 宣稱的檔案不在 diff 裡）
evals.prompt: I'm about to open the PR for this branch. PR description draft is in PR_DRAFT.md. Can you go over my change before I submit it?
evals.expected_output: Compares each claim in PR_DRAFT.md with the branch diff and reports the ones the diff does not back.
expectations: The agent looks at the branch's diff against main (e.g. git diff / git log), not only at PR_DRAFT.md
The agent reports that CHANGELOG.md is claimed as updated but is not in the diff
The agent reports that no unit test for the retry path exists in the diff, and that the retry has no backoff although the draft claims exponential backoff

evals.prompt: This branch fixes the product page crashing when an item has no price. Please check my fix before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Names the other unguarded formatPrice callers on the cart page as the same bug with the same fix, inside the symptom's scope.
expectations: The agent searches the codebase for other callers of formatPrice or the same unguarded pattern
The agent names src/pages/cart.js (cartItemLabel and/or lineTotal) as having the same missing-price problem
The agent says those places should be fixed in this PR or gives one of: not the same bug, unreachable, or a different fix — with the reason

evals.source: .claude/skills/check-your-own-work/SKILL.md:243（初始化拋錯時 loading 旗標沒人歸位）
evals.prompt: Added a loading skeleton to the plans section on this branch. Look it over before I send it for review?
evals.expected_output: Walks the failure path of load(): if getPlans rejects or groupByCategory throws, loading stays true forever.
expectations: The agent points out that state.loading is never reset to false when api.getPlans rejects or groupByCategory throws
The agent says what the user would see in that case (a skeleton that never goes away) or suggests try/finally
The agent does not report the change as having no issues

evals.source: .claude/skills/check-your-own-work/SKILL.md:199（刻意不呼叫重置那一支，換選項後金額算成 0）
evals.prompt: On this branch the option change keeps the date restored from the URL. Can you check the change before I open a PR?
evals.expected_output: Lists what resetSelection used to do and finds that qty is no longer reset to the new option's minQty.
expectations: The agent lists what resetSelection did (clear date, set qty to option.minQty, recompute total) by reading the removed lines
The agent reports that qty is no longer set to the new option's minQty after an option change, so the total can be computed on a quantity the new option does not allow
The agent does not accept the code comment's reason as covering every duty of resetSelection

evals.source: .claude/skills/check-your-own-work/SKILL.md:170（四處行為改動配三支測試，第四處沒有）

evals.source: .claude/skills/check-your-own-work/SKILL.md:219（零先例的形狀：同一則標本的另一面，repo 從來沒做過的東西）

evals.prompt: Check my change on this branch before I open the PR.

expectations: The agent does not run git push, gh pr create, or any command that sends something outside the machine

The agent reports at least one observation about the formatPrice change (e.g. an empty string for a missing amount and what callers do with it)
